title: JR Central company history
lineage: Original publisher's text inspected. Saved notes paraphrase the identified passages.

passages.note: JR Central records the Series 700 introduction to Nozomi on the Tokaido Shinkansen, the installation of new automatic train control on the line and the Series N700 introduction to Nozomi, respectively.
The chronology records the introduction of Series N700A to Nozomi and the start of commercial N700S operation.
